content.comment_body: Thank you [user_name], Does anyone know where previous firmware versions and their changelogs can be found on the [company_name] website? --- Split from Shift register not working after power failure.
For the [product_name], only the firmware update to [version_no] V1.83.02 is available. Other firmware versions like V1.81.x or V1.82.x cannot be loaded onto this [product_name].

Hello [user_name], You can view the changes here: [url] This overview may be particularly useful: Download links for the current [product_name] software and firmware. To find more FAQs about [product_name], use the knowledge base or search in the [product_name] conferences, for example: [url]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are having difficulty accessing older firmware versions and changelogs for [product_name] devices on the [company_name] website. There is confusion about where historical firmware files and their documentation can be found, along with frustration over the inability to download older versions and unclear version history.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an easily accessible archive of previous firmware versions and comprehensive changelogs on the official [company_name] website to support better version management and transparency.
